basics.name: Yunus SARIBULUT
basics.label: Senior Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer with 10 years of experience building and maintaining enterprise-grade web and mobile applications. Backend expertise in C#, ASP.NET Web Forms, .NET Framework, .NET Core 2.1/3.1, .NET 5/6/8/9, ABP Framework, and EF Core. Frontend proficiency in HTML5, CSS, SCSS, Bootstrap, Material UI, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, and Angular. Mobile development with React Native and Flutter. Database management with PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Prisma ORM. Experienced in CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, and Azure. Proven track record of leading development teams, making architectural decisions, and delivering projects from the ground up in corporate environments. Passionate about game development with Unity.

work.summary: Bilgesin is a survey platform where users share their opinions with brands and earn discounts in return.
highlights: Serving as CTO, responsible for all technology strategy, infrastructure, and development decisions.
Built the entire technical infrastructure from scratch including backend, frontend, and backoffice applications.
Developed coupon management, reporting, and analytics features to drive user engagement.
Managing and scaling the platform architecture to handle growing user base.

work.summary: Innfinitive is a technology company developing HRinONE (comprehensive HR management platform) and HireInOne (AI-powered recruitment solution).
highlights: Promoted from Full Stack Developer to Lead Developer, leading architectural decisions and team management.
Developed backend and frontend for HRinONE, a comprehensive platform managing all HR processes including employee management, demand management, and authentication.
Built the HRinONE mobile app from the ground up with React Native, integrating notifications, FaceID, and real-time features via SignalR.
Developed backend and frontend for HireInOne, an AI-powered recruitment platform with candidate web app, profile management, and resume management.
Integrated external data sources including SGK (Social Security), SAP, and PDKS (access control devices).
Managed and maintained PostgreSQL databases, Redis caching layers, and Docker/Kubernetes deployments.
HRinONE available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.hrinone) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hrinone/id1573424216).
